Subject: Intermittent empty output from text-generation API

Hi Priyom —

We're seeing intermittent 'empty' generations (zero tokens returned) from the Redwood text generation endpoint for one of our integration tests. The failures started happening around 08:00 PDT on 2026-09-28 and have occurred ~4 times in the last 24 hours.

Sample request attached (example_request.json). The requests are using model: rwd-7b-v2, convo length ~240 tokens. We are calling via the official JS SDK (v1.3.0).

This is blocking a canary release — can you confirm whether this is a platform issue or if we are sending a malformed payload?

Ticket: RED-67894

Thanks,
Alex
Staff ML Engineer — Solara Labs
[Attachment: example_request.json (application/json)]

Thanks for the report and the sample. I'm looping in Evelyn and Dev from triage. Quick questions while we start reproducing:

- Do you see any pattern on prompt contents or client-side pre/post-processing?

From: dev_patel@redwood.ai
To: priyom_das@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-29T11:35:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent empty output from text-generation API

Triage notes (internal):
- Replayed the exact payloads from example_request.json and the two request_ids against rwd-7b-v2 in us-west-2 and us-central-1 via our internal replay harness. No empty outputs observed; responses contain tokens as expected.
- Verified model runtime logs for the windows containing the two request_ids — no runtime exceptions, no OOMs, normal token emission.
- Checked our gateway logs: the responses to those request_ids show 200 responses with a non-empty body in our internal logs. The customer's SDK seems to have an empty "choices" array despite the gateway returning content.
- Hypothesis: client-side parsing or SDK v1.3.0 mishandles streamed partial payloads when there is an upstream connection hiccup. No platform evidence of generation failure.

Action items: ask customer for exact SDK logs (response headers + raw body) for the failing calls; ask them to reproduce with SDK v1.4.0-beta that contains a stream-handling fix.

— Dev Patel
Senior SRE — Redwood Inference

From: evelyn_hart@redwood.ai
To: Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@solaralabs.com>, Jamie Rhee <jamie.rhee@solaralabs.com>, priyom_das@redwood.ai, dev_patel@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-09-30T10:02:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Intermittent empty output from text-generation API

Alex / Jamie —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Summary from our end after running the provided payloads and correlating request_ids:
- We could not reproduce empty outputs on the Redwood platform for the same requests and time windows you provided. Internal traces indicate successful token emission and standard stream termination.
- No infra incidents or recent deploys correlate to the timestamps you reported.
- Likely root cause is client-side: either SDK stream handling (known edge case in 1.3.0) or transient network fragmentation between the SDK and the gateway that resulted in an incomplete parse on the client.

Recommended next steps for Solara to confirm:
1) Re-run the failing request with SDK v1.4.0-beta (contains a fix for stream partial reads).
2) If failures persist, capture raw TCP logs or the full raw HTTP body returned by the gateway for the failing request_id and share with us.

We'll hold on any platform-side remediation while you validate. If you see any new request_ids with full raw bodies showing an empty generation, flag those and we'll re-open a deeper platform investigation.

If you want, we can schedule a 30-minute joint debugging session tomorrow to reproduce live.

— Evelyn Hart
Principal Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: Alex Hsu <alex.hsu@solaralabs.com>, Jamie Rhee <jamie.rhee@solaralabs.com>
Cc: dev_patel@redwood.ai, evelyn_hart@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: 2026-10-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Closure: Solara Labs report — no platform evidence of empty generation

Alex / Jamie —

Following our triage: we were unable to find platform-side evidence of empty generations for the request_ids you shared. Key points and actions taken:
- Replayed payloads across regions and model variants; platform responses included normal token output.
- Gateway and runtime logs correlated to the customer's request_ids show successful completions.
- We identified a likely client-side stream handling edge-case in SDK v1.3.0; Dev reproduced the discrepancy where a transient network fragmentation can result in the SDK recording an empty "choices" array while the gateway had sent content.

Actions we took on our side:
- Verified logs and replayed requests (no infra anomalies found).
- Prepared mitigation guidance and a recommended reproduction checklist (linked in ticket).

Suggested customer next steps:
- Upgrade to SDK v1.4.0-beta and re-run the failing requests.
- If issue reproduces, collect raw HTTP bodies and request_id and re-open the ticket.

I'm marking this thread as closed from the platform-investigation side. If you'd like the joint debugging session Evelyn offered, reply and we'll schedule.

Thanks for working with us — sorry for the disruption during your canary.

— Priyom Das
Customer Reliability — Redwood Inference
